zh-tw.heading: 固定與可調政策
zh-tw.intro: 只列公版主要政策、可調選項與設定位置。

en.heading: Fixed and adjustable policy
en.intro: Only the template's main policy, adjustable options, and setting locations are listed.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜四種 Issue 表單與必填內容
title.en: Fixed baseline | Four Issue forms and their required fields

goal.zh-tw: 提供 Feature、Task、Bug、Documentation 四個入口；都要求問題與完成條件，並關閉空白 Issue。
goal.en: Four entry points are provided: Feature, Task, Bug, and Documentation; all require a problem statement and acceptance criteria, and blank Issues are disabled.

code.zh-tw:
Feature       -> Type: Feature; label: enhancement
Task          -> Type: Task; label: enhancement
Bug           -> Type: Bug; label: bug
Documentation -> Type: Task; label: documentation

Required fields:
  - problem
  - acceptance

# config.yml
blank_issues_enabled: false
contact_links: []
code.en:
Feature       -> Type: Feature; label: enhancement
Task          -> Type: Task; label: enhancement
Bug           -> Type: Bug; label: bug
Documentation -> Type: Task; label: documentation

Required fields:
  - problem
  - acceptance

# config.yml
blank_issues_enabled: false
contact_links: []

summary.zh-tw: 問題與完成條件必填，空白 Issue 關閉；這些是公版工作契約，不提供停用開關。
summary.en: The problem and acceptance criteria are required and blank Issues stay disabled; these are template work-item contracts with no opt-out switch.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜標題、Label、負責人與工作層級
title.en: Fixed baseline | Title, label, assignee, and work hierarchy

goal.zh-tw: 標題使用 12–80 個英文 ASCII 字元及至少三個詞；建立者自我指派，agent／CLI 使用 @me。
goal.en: A title uses 12-80 ASCII characters and at least three words; the creator self-assigns, and an agent or the CLI uses @me.

code.zh-tw:
Title: 12-80 ASCII characters; at least 3 words
Assignee: creator; agent/CLI uses @me

Other classifications:
  documentation -> Task + documentation label
  duplicate     -> duplicate close reason
  hotfix        -> Bug + hotfix label + fix/<Issue>-* -> main
  promotion     -> delivery tracking only

Parent     -> shared outcome still incomplete
Dependency -> actual execution order
code.en:
Title: 12-80 ASCII characters; at least 3 words
Assignee: creator; agent/CLI uses @me

Other classifications:
  documentation -> Task + documentation label
  duplicate     -> duplicate close reason
  hotfix        -> Bug + hotfix label + fix/<Issue>-* -> main
  promotion     -> delivery tracking only

Parent     -> shared outcome still incomplete
Dependency -> actual execution order

summary.zh-tw: 標題、分類與工作關係採同一套規則；組織若要改契約，應由公版政策變更而不是各 repo 自行關閉。
summary.en: Title, classification, and work-item relationships follow one shared rule set; an organization that wants to change the contract should change the template policy, not disable the rule in individual repositories.

title.zh-tw: 專案選擇｜規格要不要建立追蹤工作
title.en: Project choice | Whether a spec creates a tracking work item

goal.zh-tw: 各專案在 `docs/specs/` 寫長期規格；front matter 決定同步 Task、Feature，或只保存文件。
goal.en: Each project writes long-lived specs under `docs/specs/`; front matter decides whether it syncs to a Task, a Feature, or stays a document only.

code.zh-tw:
tracking: issue  # Sync one Task
tracking: story  # Sync one Feature parent
tracking: none   # Keep the current contract only

python scripts/spec_to_issue.py validate
code.en:
tracking: issue  # Sync one Task
tracking: story  # Sync one Feature parent
tracking: none   # Keep the current contract only

python scripts/spec_to_issue.py validate

summary.zh-tw: 現階段沿用單一輕量格式，不另導入 Spec Kit；需求真的需要完整 spec／plan／tasks 流程時再評估。
summary.en: The current stage keeps one lightweight format instead of adopting a separate Spec Kit; a full spec/plan/tasks workflow is evaluated only once the need is real.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜里程碑的啟動門檻
title.en: Fixed baseline | A Milestone's kickoff threshold

goal.zh-tw: 每個里程碑使用一張生命週期追蹤 Issue，集中保存同意與反駁。
goal.en: Every Milestone uses one lifecycle tracking Issue that keeps agreement and objections in one place.

code.zh-tw:
## Problem
## Outcome
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable result
## Plan
- #123 — Independently deliverable work
## Kickoff decision
- Approval: one non-proposer agreement
- Objections: none unresolved
## Out of scope
## Verification
## References
code.en:
## Problem
## Outcome
## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Observable result
## Plan
- #123 — Independently deliverable work
## Kickoff decision
- Approval: one non-proposer agreement
- Objections: none unresolved
## Out of scope
## Verification
## References

summary.zh-tw: 至少一位非提案者同意，且沒有尚未解決的反駁，工作才開始；里程碑結案方式由「版本／交付」定義。
summary.en: Work starts only after at least one person other than the proposer agrees and no objection remains unresolved; how a Milestone closes is defined under Version / Delivery.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜人與 AI 各看一個清楚入口
title.en: Fixed baseline | People and AI each get one clear entry point

goal.zh-tw: README 服務人；根目錄 AGENTS.md 是 AI 規範唯一來源，CLAUDE.md 只薄匯入。
goal.en: README serves people; the root AGENTS.md is the single source of AI rules, and CLAUDE.md is only a thin import.

code.zh-tw:
# README.md
## Quick start
## Verification
## Support

# AGENTS.md
## Scope and sources of truth
## Working loop
## Commands
## Editing boundaries
## Safety
code.en:
# README.md
## Quick start
## Verification
## Support

# AGENTS.md
## Scope and sources of truth
## Working loop
## Commands
## Editing boundaries
## Safety

summary.zh-tw: 子目錄只有命令或安全界線真的不同時才增加 AGENTS.md，避免多份規範漂移。
summary.en: A subdirectory gets its own AGENTS.md only when its commands or safety boundaries genuinely differ, so multiple rule files never drift apart.

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜產品啟動與額外驗證命令
title.en: Adjustable | Product startup and extra verification commands

goal.zh-tw: 讓 agent 知道怎麼啟動產品，以及共通驗證完成後還要執行哪一支專案檢查。
goal.en: Tells the agent how to start the product, and which project-specific check to run after the shared verification finishes.

code.zh-tw:
project_run_command: uv run my-product
project_verification_hook: scripts/verify-product
code.en:
project_run_command: uv run my-product
project_verification_hook: scripts/verify-product

summary.zh-tw: `project_run_command` 必填；既有 repo 可選填一支安全的 repository-relative 驗證程式。
summary.en: `project_run_command` is required; an existing repository may also set one safe, repository-relative verification program.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜平行可寫工作各自隔離
title.en: Fixed baseline | Parallel writable tasks stay isolated

goal.zh-tw: 一項可寫工作對應一個 branch 與 worktree，只平行處理互不依賴的範圍。
goal.en: One writable task maps to one branch and one worktree; only independent scopes run in parallel.

code.zh-tw:
git worktree add ../task-388 -b feat/388-align-ai-guidelines
./scripts/test-worktree-cleanup
./scripts/cleanup-worktrees
code.en:
git worktree add ../task-388 -b feat/388-align-ai-guidelines
./scripts/test-worktree-cleanup
./scripts/cleanup-worktrees

summary.zh-tw: 唯讀工作不需另開 worktree；清理程式只回收已合併且乾淨的目錄。
summary.en: A read-only task needs no extra worktree; the cleanup program reclaims only merged, clean directories.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜規範、驗證與治理各有唯一責任
title.en: Fixed baseline | Rules, verification, and governance each own one responsibility

goal.zh-tw: AGENTS.md 說明怎麼做；scripts 提供證據；Action 只包裝執行；規則治理單獨定義合併資格、權限與例外。
goal.en: AGENTS.md explains how to work; scripts supply evidence; Actions only wrap execution; rules governance separately defines merge eligibility, permissions, and exceptions.

code.zh-tw:
# Local and Action use the same logic
./scripts/verify

# Governance and merge eligibility live under Rules governance
policies/actions.json
policies/rulesets.json
code.en:
# Local and Action use the same logic
./scripts/verify

# Governance and merge eligibility live under Rules governance
policies/actions.json
policies/rulesets.json

summary.zh-tw: 人保留需求、重大取捨、外部影響與不可逆操作；本頁不重複定義合併權限。
summary.en: People retain requirements, major trade-offs, external impact, and irreversible operations; this page does not redefine merge permissions.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜CI 依風險執行 fast 或 full
title.en: Fixed baseline | CI runs fast or full by risk

goal.zh-tw: 預設路徑不依賴中央 workflow；穩定 aggregate context 兼顧成本與 required checks。
goal.en: The default path does not depend on a central workflow; a stable aggregate context balances cost against required checks.

code.zh-tw:
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
jobs:
  fast: # docs／fast routing
  full: # promotion／hotfix／merge queue／manual
  verify: # always-present aggregate context
code.en:
on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
jobs:
  fast: # docs/fast routing
  full: # promotion/hotfix/merge queue/manual
  verify: # always-present aggregate context

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜覆蓋率與本機便利功能
title.en: Adjustable | Coverage and local convenience features

goal.zh-tw: 組織可以調整共用覆蓋率政策與 pre-commit，不需要修改每支驗證腳本。
goal.en: An organization can adjust the shared coverage policy and pre-commit without editing every verification script.

code.zh-tw:
coverage_mode: global  # global | diff
coverage_threshold: 80  # 1..100
enable_precommit: false
code.en:
coverage_mode: global  # global | diff
coverage_threshold: 80  # 1..100
enable_precommit: false

summary.zh-tw: 覆蓋率可選全專案或只看本次差異，門檻預設 80%；pre-commit 預設關閉，CI 仍是必要證據。
summary.en: Coverage can target the whole project or only the current diff, with an 80% default threshold; pre-commit defaults to off, and CI remains the required evidence.

title.zh-tw: 專案選配｜改用固定版本的 reusable workflow
title.en: Project opt-in | Switch to a pinned reusable workflow

goal.zh-tw: Copier 預設關閉；啟用時必須輸入 40 字元 commit SHA，中央 private repo 另須允許 organization 存取。
goal.en: Copier keeps this off by default; enabling it requires a 40-character commit SHA, and the central private repository must also allow organization-level access.

code.zh-tw:
use_reusable_workflow: true
workflow_ref: <40-character-commit-sha>

uses: Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/.github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml@<40-character-commit-sha>
with:
  language-profile: python

gh api --method PUT \
  repos/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/actions/permissions/access \
  -f access_level=organization
code.en:
use_reusable_workflow: true
workflow_ref: <40-character-commit-sha>

uses: Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/.github/workflows/reusable-ci.yml@<40-character-commit-sha>
with:
  language-profile: python

gh api --method PUT \
  repos/Innoguard-Cyber-Arch/csarc-repo-template/actions/permissions/access \
  -f access_level=organization

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜zizmor 只在相關變更與排程執行
title.en: Fixed baseline | zizmor runs only on relevant changes and on schedule

goal.zh-tw: workflow／action 變更與 promotion 由 CI 條件式掃描；每週另掃一次，普通 source／docs PR 不重複付費。
goal.en: CI conditionally scans workflow/action changes and promotions; a weekly run covers the rest, so an ordinary source or docs PR never pays for it twice.

code.zh-tw:
name: Zizmor scheduled audit
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "43 3 * * 1"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  audit:
    steps:
      - run: uvx --from zizmor==1.29.0 zizmor . --format plain
# PR workflow changes are routed to the same audit by the CI tier rules.
code.en:
name: Zizmor scheduled audit
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "43 3 * * 1"
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  audit:
    steps:
      - run: uvx --from zizmor==1.29.0 zizmor . --format plain
# PR workflow changes are routed to the same audit by the CI tier rules.

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜選用語言與 Python 支援範圍
title.en: Adjustable | Selected languages and Python support range

goal.zh-tw: Copier 將選擇寫進 repo；偵測器只負責提醒實際檔案與宣告不一致，不擅自改設定。
goal.en: Copier writes the selection into the repository; the detector only flags when the actual files disagree with the declaration, and never changes the setting on its own.

code.zh-tw:
languages:
- python
- rust
- typescript
python_support_mode: latest  # latest | minimum
python_min_version: "3.12"  # minimum only
./scripts/detect-language-profile --suggest
./scripts/detect-language-profile
code.en:
languages:
- python
- rust
- typescript
python_support_mode: latest  # latest | minimum
python_min_version: "3.12"  # minimum only
./scripts/detect-language-profile --suggest
./scripts/detect-language-profile

summary.zh-tw: `languages` 決定要產生哪些語言模組；Python 另可選最新穩定版或最低支援版本。
summary.en: `languages` decides which language modules are generated; Python can additionally target the latest stable release or the lowest supported version.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜各語言使用原生工具
title.en: Fixed baseline | Each language uses its native tools

goal.zh-tw: 共用治理不等於硬湊成同一套工具；每種語言使用其主流工具，再由同一驗證入口協調。
goal.en: Shared governance does not mean forcing every language into the same toolchain; each language uses its mainstream tools, coordinated behind one verification entry point.

code.zh-tw:
# Python module
uv sync --locked
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run ruff check .
uv run ty check
uv run pytest --cov --cov-fail-under=80

# Rust module
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --all-features
cargo build --release --locked
cargo package --locked --allow-dirty

# TypeScript module
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm exec biome ci .
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
pnpm exec vitest run --coverage
code.en:
# Python module
uv sync --locked
uv run ruff format --check .
uv run ruff check .
uv run ty check
uv run pytest --cov --cov-fail-under=80

# Rust module
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
cargo test --locked --all-features
cargo build --release --locked
cargo package --locked --allow-dirty

# TypeScript module
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
pnpm exec biome ci .
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit
pnpm exec vitest run --coverage

summary.zh-tw: Ruff／Biome／rustfmt 負責格式，Ruff／Biome／Clippy 負責 lint；ty／TypeScript 檢查型別，各語言再使用自己的測試與打包工具。
summary.en: Ruff, Biome, and rustfmt own formatting; Ruff, Biome, and Clippy own linting; ty and TypeScript check types; each language then uses its own testing and packaging tools.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜一個入口驗證與打包
title.en: Fixed baseline | One entry point verifies and packages

goal.zh-tw: 本機、AI 與 GitHub 執行同一入口；各語言只持有自己的檢查。
goal.en: Local runs, AI, and GitHub all execute the same entry point; each language owns only its own checks.

code.zh-tw:
./scripts/verify-fast
./scripts/verify
code.en:
./scripts/verify-fast
./scripts/verify

summary.zh-tw: fast 選必要子集，full 是其超集合，不為不同 PR 階段複製測試。
summary.en: `fast` selects the required subset and `full` is its superset; no test is duplicated for a different PR stage.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜PR 格式與工作關聯
title.en: Fixed baseline | PR format and its work-item link

goal.zh-tw: 一張工作 PR 完成一張 Issue；里程碑工作由 Action 核對後關單，直接進 main 則沿用 GitHub 原生關單。
goal.en: One work PR completes one Issue; an Action verifies and closes Milestone work, while work that lands directly on main relies on GitHub's native closing keywords.

code.zh-tw:
title: feat(scope): English summary
branch: feat/123-short-slug
body: Closes #123
label: enhancement
assignee: PR author
milestone: same as Issue #123
code.en:
title: feat(scope): English summary
branch: feat/123-short-slug
body: Closes #123
label: enhancement
assignee: PR author
milestone: same as Issue #123

summary.zh-tw: 標題與目的分支符合規則；分類 Label 與里程碑必須和 Issue 相同，PR 作者必須列為 Assignee，內文使用 Closes #N 連回同號未結案 Issue。
summary.en: The title and base branch must follow the rules; the classification label and Milestone must match the Issue, the PR author must be listed as Assignee, and the body must use `Closes #N` to link back to the matching open Issue.

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜工作 PR 的分支模型
title.en: Adjustable | The work PR's branch model

goal.zh-tw: 里程碑工作先進 dev/m*，一般獨立工作直接進 main；main 更新後以 PR 同步，不直接改寫開發分支。
goal.en: Milestone work lands on `dev/m*` first, while an ordinary independent task goes straight to main; once main moves forward, a PR syncs it back instead of rewriting the delivery branch directly.

code.zh-tw:
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main

work:    type/123-short-slug -> dev/m8-*
release: dev/m8-* -> main
sync:    sync/main-to-m8-*-<sha> -> dev/m8-*
code.en:
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main

work:    type/123-short-slug -> dev/m8-*
release: dev/m8-* -> main
sync:    sync/main-to-m8-*-<sha> -> dev/m8-*

summary.zh-tw: `branch_strategy` 可選 delivery 或 main；validator 依所選模型檢查目的分支與同步鏈。
summary.en: `branch_strategy` selects `delivery` or `main`; the validator checks the base branch and sync chain against the selected model.

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜程式碼擁有者與審查人選
title.en: Adjustable | Code owners and review candidates

goal.zh-tw: 公版產生 CODEOWNERS 與可輪派名單；誰可以合併及例外仍只由規則治理定義。
goal.en: The template generates CODEOWNERS and an assignable reviewer list; who may merge and any exception are still defined only by rules governance.

code.zh-tw:
code_owner: "@organization/team"
reviewers: "@alice,@bob"

desired reviews: 1
require CODEOWNER: true
dismiss stale reviews: true
resolve review threads: true

# Run before relying on enforcement
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh check
code.en:
code_owner: "@organization/team"
reviewers: "@alice,@bob"

desired reviews: 1
require CODEOWNER: true
dismiss stale reviews: true
resolve review threads: true

# Run before relying on enforcement
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh check

summary.zh-tw: `code_owner` 指定 GitHub team；`reviewers` 是可輪派的帳號名單。平台無法強制時仍需人工指定與確認。
summary.en: `code_owner` names a GitHub team; `reviewers` is the list of accounts that can be assigned. When the platform cannot enforce this, a human must still assign and confirm it.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜依鎖檔重裝，TypeScript 另等三天
title.en: Fixed baseline | Reinstall from the lockfile; TypeScript also waits three days

goal.zh-tw: 先證明已提交的套件集合可以重現，不把「安裝成功」誤當成「沒有漏洞」。
goal.en: First prove the committed package set is reproducible; a successful install is never mistaken for the absence of vulnerabilities.

code.zh-tw:
uv sync --locked
cargo test --locked
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

minimumReleaseAge: 4320
minimumReleaseAgeStrict: true
trustPolicy: no-downgrade
code.en:
uv sync --locked
cargo test --locked
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

minimumReleaseAge: 4320
minimumReleaseAgeStrict: true
trustPolicy: no-downgrade

summary.zh-tw: Python、Rust、TypeScript 都依 lockfile 重裝；pnpm 另拒絕發布未滿三天或 publisher trust 降級的版本。
summary.en: Python, Rust, and TypeScript all reinstall from their lockfile; pnpm additionally refuses a release published under three days ago or with a downgraded publisher trust level.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜Dependabot 提出一般與安全更新 PR
title.en: Fixed baseline | Dependabot opens both routine and security update PRs

goal.zh-tw: 一般新版先觀察三天；已知安全修補不等待，且更新 PR 繼續走相同 CI。
goal.en: An ordinary new release is observed for three days first; a known security fix does not wait, and update PRs still go through the same CI.

code.zh-tw:
cooldown:
  default-days: 3

# Security updates are not delayed by the cooldown.
code.en:
cooldown:
  default-days: 3

# Security updates are not delayed by the cooldown.

summary.zh-tw: 使用 GitHub 原生 automation identity，不要求每個 repo 安裝高權限 App；一般更新與安全更新 PR 都走相同審查與 CI。
summary.en: This uses GitHub's native automation identity instead of requiring a high-privilege App on every repository; both routine and security update PRs go through the same review and CI.

title.zh-tw: 固定基線｜OSV 共用本機、PR 與每週掃描
title.en: Fixed baseline | OSV shares one scan across local runs, PRs, and the weekly schedule

goal.zh-tw: 已公開漏洞立即處理，不和一般新版的三天觀察混在一起。
goal.en: A publicly disclosed vulnerability is handled immediately, kept separate from the three-day observation window for ordinary releases.

code.zh-tw:
Issue PR with dependency changes -> verify-dependencies
Delivery PR -> verify-dependencies
Weekly schedule -> verify-dependencies
code.en:
Issue PR with dependency changes -> verify-dependencies
Delivery PR -> verify-dependencies
Weekly schedule -> verify-dependencies

summary.zh-tw: 依賴檔變更與交付候選執行同一支本機程式；每週排程只補沒有 PR 的期間。workflow 不自行重寫掃描條件。
summary.en: A dependency-file change and a delivery candidate both run the same local program; the weekly schedule only covers periods without a PR. No workflow redefines the scan conditions on its own.

title.zh-tw: 專案選配｜依 GitHub 方案啟用 CodeQL
title.en: Project opt-in | Enable CodeQL by GitHub plan

goal.zh-tw: 需要跨函式資料流分析時啟用 SAST；不能把 lint 或套件漏洞掃描誤當成 CodeQL。
goal.en: SAST is enabled when cross-function data-flow analysis is actually needed; lint or dependency-vulnerability scanning is never mistaken for CodeQL.

code.zh-tw:
project_visibility: public
enable_codeql: true
code.en:
project_visibility: public
enable_codeql: true

summary.zh-tw: public repo 預設開啟；private／internal repo 先確認 GitHub Code Security 授權，未選 Python 或 TypeScript 時不產生。
summary.en: A public repository turns this on by default; a private or internal repository first confirms GitHub Code Security authorization, and nothing is generated unless Python or TypeScript is selected.

title.zh-tw: 條件式契約｜真正成品的 SPDX SBOM 與 checksum
title.en: Conditional contract | SPDX SBOM and checksums for real artifacts

goal.zh-tw: 清冊必須來自精確 tag 的真正成品，不能只從原始碼猜測。
goal.en: The inventory must come from the real artifact at an exact tag; it is never guessed from source code alone.

code.zh-tw:
syft <extracted-artifacts> -o spdx-json=sbom.spdx.json
python scripts/release_assets.py build ...
python scripts/release_assets.py verify ...
code.en:
syft <extracted-artifacts> -o spdx-json=sbom.spdx.json
python scripts/release_assets.py build ...
python scripts/release_assets.py verify ...

summary.zh-tw: 成品存在時可用 Syft 產生 SPDX 2.3 SBOM；repo 程式驗證 root package、dependency graph、checksum、來源與 provenance。目前沒有 active publisher，因此不宣稱已產生成品證據。
summary.en: When an artifact exists, Syft can generate an SPDX 2.3 SBOM; repository scripts verify the root package, dependency graph, checksum, source identity, and provenance. There is currently no active publisher, so no artifact evidence is claimed to exist yet.

title.zh-tw: 可調整｜回報本專案自身的漏洞
title.en: Adjustable | Reporting a vulnerability in this project itself

goal.zh-tw: 掃描工具只看得到已知模式；有人主動回報才補得到掃描漏抓的問題。Issue 是公開索引的，通報流程要先把人導離開 Issue。
goal.en: Scanning tools can only see known patterns; a human report is what catches what scanning misses. Issues are publicly indexed, so the reporting process first routes people away from the Issue tracker.

code.zh-tw:
security_reporting_channel: >-
  Use the approved private reporting channel.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub Issue for a
suspected vulnerability, exploit code,
credentials, tokens, or customer data.

<!-- Project owner: replace with the actual
private reporting channel and expected
acknowledgement window. -->
code.en:
security_reporting_channel: >-
  Use the approved private reporting channel.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public GitHub Issue for a
suspected vulnerability, exploit code,
credentials, tokens, or customer data.

<!-- Project owner: replace with the actual
private reporting channel and expected
acknowledgement window. -->

summary.zh-tw: 不寫死聯絡信箱或 SLA：模板不知道下游專案的實際通報管道，假造一個反而誤導回報者。專案 owner 必須在 `SECURITY.md` 填入實際管道與回應期待後，這份政策才算生效。
summary.en: No contact address or SLA is hard-coded: the template does not know a downstream project's real reporting channel, and inventing one would only mislead reporters. This policy takes effect only after the project owner fills in the real channel and response expectations in `SECURITY.md`.

title.zh-tw: 人工邊界｜交付與里程碑結案分開
title.en: Human boundary | Delivery and Milestone closure stay separate

goal.zh-tw: 合併到 main 不等於發版；里程碑完成仍須由 owner 確認 outcome 與必要證據。
goal.en: Merging into main is not a release; a Milestone still needs its owner to confirm the outcome and the required evidence.

code.zh-tw:
normal completion:
  delivery evidence: recorded
  unfinished Issues: none
  lifecycle Issue: completed

early termination:
  reason: recorded
  unfinished Issues: moved or not planned
  lifecycle Issue: not planned
code.en:
normal completion:
  delivery evidence: recorded
  unfinished Issues: none
  lifecycle Issue: completed

early termination:
  reason: recorded
  unfinished Issues: moved or not planned
  lifecycle Issue: not planned

summary.zh-tw: #400 完成前，正常結案與提前終止都維持人工；不由 release workflow 推測完成。
summary.en: Until #400 is complete, both normal closure and early termination stay manual; a release workflow never infers completion on its own.

title.zh-tw: 目前狀態｜發版 automation 未啟用
title.en: Current state | Release automation is not enabled

goal.zh-tw: 文件只宣稱目前 repository 能由 active file 與 current run 證明的能力。
goal.en: Documentation claims only the capability that the repository's current active files and current runs can actually prove.

code.zh-tw:
version intent: active
version + changelog: manual
tag + GitHub Release: blocked (#369)
artifact evidence: conditional
deployment: not applicable
code.en:
version intent: active
version + changelog: manual
tag + GitHub Release: blocked (#369)
artifact evidence: conditional
deployment: not applicable

summary.zh-tw: Release Please、promotion、成品發布與 consumption workflows 都在 archive；#369 決定唯一 owner 前維持 manual／conditional。
summary.en: Release Please, promotion, artifact publication, and consumption workflows all sit in the archive; they stay manual or conditional until #369 decides on a single owner.

title.zh-tw: 保留契約｜成品與消費驗證可在本機重跑
title.en: Retained contract | Artifact and consumption verification can rerun locally

goal.zh-tw: 保留 exact-tag、checksum、SBOM、provenance 與 consumption 的 fail-closed 邊界，不假裝已有 publisher。
goal.en: The exact-tag, checksum, SBOM, provenance, and consumption fail-closed boundaries are kept in place, without pretending a publisher already exists.

code.zh-tw:
build exact-tag artifacts
verify SHA-256 + SPDX 2.3 + source identity
publish only after an owner is approved
consumer verifies its own policy
code.en:
build exact-tag artifacts
verify SHA-256 + SPDX 2.3 + source identity
publish only after an owner is approved
consumer verifies its own policy

summary.zh-tw: scripts／tests 是 conditional contract；真正 workflow 必須另行定義 owner、trigger、最小權限、timeout、concurrency、成本與成功／受控失敗 evidence。
summary.en: The scripts and tests form a conditional contract; an actual workflow would still need to separately define an owner, trigger, least-privilege permissions, timeout, concurrency, cost, and success/controlled-failure evidence.

title.zh-tw: 單一來源｜治理只保存高價值選項
title.en: Single source | Governance keeps only high-value options

goal.zh-tw: root、生成 repo 與衍生公版共用同一份公開設定，不再維護 profile 或網站專用設定檔。
goal.en: The root, generated repositories, and derived templates share one public configuration; there is no separate profile or site-only settings file to maintain.

code.zh-tw:
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main
code_owner: "@organization/team"
reviewers: "@alice,@bob"
project_visibility: private  # public | private | internal
enable_governance_drift_check: false
code.en:
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main
code_owner: "@organization/team"
reviewers: "@alice,@bob"
project_visibility: private  # public | private | internal
enable_governance_drift_check: false

summary.zh-tw: 分支、owner、reviewer、可見性與治理漂移選配存在 `.csarc/config.yml`；低頻 GitHub 原生細節仍留在 `policies/`。生成 repo 才另含 Copier 來源 metadata。
summary.en: Branch model, owner, reviewers, visibility, and the optional governance-drift check live in `.csarc/config.yml`; low-frequency native GitHub detail stays in `policies/`. Only a generated repository also carries Copier source metadata.

title.zh-tw: 分開檢查 Ruleset policy、遠端儲存與實際強制能力
title.en: Check Ruleset policy, remote storage, and actual enforcement separately

goal.zh-tw: Copier 建檔時可能還沒有遠端 repo；真正套用前再向 GitHub 查詢，避免依使用者手填的方案猜測。
goal.en: A remote repository may not exist yet when Copier generates files; the actual apply step queries GitHub instead of guessing the plan from a user-filled answer.

code.zh-tw:
gh api "repos/$repo"   --jq '[.owner.login, .owner.type, .visibility, .permissions.admin] | @tsv'
gh api "orgs/$owner" --jq '.plan.name'
gh api "repos/$repo/rulesets"
# Free private keeps the desired policy in the repository.

./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh plan
code.en:
gh api "repos/$repo"   --jq '[.owner.login, .owner.type, .visibility, .permissions.admin] | @tsv'
gh api "orgs/$owner" --jq '.plan.name'
gh api "repos/$repo/rulesets"
# Free private keeps the desired policy in the repository.

./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh plan

summary.zh-tw: 先確認登入者具有 repo admin；REST endpoint 判斷 GitHub 是否會強制規則。Free private 的 REST 與 GraphQL mutation 都會回 403；GraphQL query 僅用來偵測管理員是否曾從 Web UI 人工預建。其他未知錯誤會停止。
summary.en: First confirm the signed-in user has repo admin; a REST endpoint then tells whether GitHub will actually enforce the rule. Both the REST and GraphQL mutation return 403 on a free private repository; the GraphQL query only detects whether an admin already pre-built the ruleset by hand in the web UI. Any other unknown error stops the run.

title.zh-tw: 所有方案都套基本設定並保留政策來源
title.en: Every plan applies the baseline settings and keeps the policy source

goal.zh-tw: Free private repo 不整包放棄；合併方式、Actions 預設權限、標籤與未來要啟用的 Ruleset 都跟著公版。
goal.en: A free private repository is never fully skipped; the merge method, default Actions permissions, labels, and the Ruleset to enable later all follow the shared template.

code.zh-tw:
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh plan
# Review the APPLY and PRESERVE list first.
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh apply
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh check
code.en:
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh plan
# Review the APPLY and PRESERVE list first.
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh apply
./scripts/apply-repository-settings.sh check

summary.zh-tw: Free private 直接套用 squash-only、刪除已合併分支、Actions 預設唯讀與標籤，並在 repo 內保留 ACTIVE Ruleset policy。公開 API 不能建立該 Ruleset，因此輸出保留 DEGRADED。
summary.en: A free private repository directly applies squash-only merges, deletes merged branches, sets Actions to read-only by default, and applies labels, while keeping the Ruleset policy recorded as ACTIVE in the repository. The public API cannot create that Ruleset, so the output is reported as DEGRADED.

title.zh-tw: 方案決定 Ruleset 是否成為真正門禁
title.en: The plan decides whether the Ruleset becomes a real gate

goal.zh-tw: Free private 先在 repo 保存相同政策；public、Pro、Team 或 Enterprise 可強制 PR、一位核准、CODEOWNER 與必要檢查。Enterprise 的組織規則仍另審。
goal.en: A free private repository first keeps the same policy stored in the repository; public, Pro, Team, or Enterprise plans can actually enforce a PR, one approval, a CODEOWNER review, and required checks. Enterprise organization rules are still reviewed separately.

code.zh-tw:
# The same policy is stored in every repository and enforced when supported.
required reviews: 1
require CODEOWNER review: true
required checks:
  - verify
  - title
  - scan-pr / osv-scan
  - audit

# Enterprise organization controls are report-only here.
code.en:
# The same policy is stored in every repository and enforced when supported.
required reviews: 1
require CODEOWNER review: true
required checks:
  - verify
  - title
  - scan-pr / osv-scan
  - audit

# Enterprise organization controls are report-only here.

summary.zh-tw: 所有方案都先用 repository teams API 驗證 PR 內設定的 team 與 write access；Action 從 base branch 的 REVIEWERS 排除作者後輪派一位個別 reviewer。Free private 仍沒有 team request 或 merge gate。Ruleset 只保留 STAGED／MISSING 與 DEGRADED 紀錄。
summary.en: Every plan first uses the repository teams API to verify the team and write access configured in the PR; an Action then excludes the author from the base branch's REVIEWERS list and assigns one individual reviewer. A free private repository still gets no team request or merge gate. The Ruleset only records STAGED/MISSING and DEGRADED states.

title.zh-tw: 治理漂移排程隨生成 repo 選配開啟，本模板 source 不自跑
title.en: The drift schedule is opt-in per generated repository; this template's own source repo does not self-run it

goal.zh-tw: 本機與生成 repo 都重複使用同一支腳本；需要持續監測時，Copier 選項開啟每日排程、least-privilege 權限、timeout 與 Issue 通知，不必個別重建。
goal.en: Both the local checkout and a generated repository reuse the same script; when continuous monitoring is needed, a Copier option turns on the daily schedule, least-privilege permissions, a timeout, and Issue notification, with nothing to rebuild by hand.

code.zh-tw:
./scripts/check-governance-drift

# enable_governance_drift_check=true generates the daily workflow and
# script together; false generates neither. This template's own source
# repo keeps the script for local verification but does not schedule it.
code.en:
./scripts/check-governance-drift

# enable_governance_drift_check=true generates the daily workflow and
# script together; false generates neither. This template's own source
# repo keeps the script for local verification but does not schedule it.

summary.zh-tw: `scripts/check-governance-drift` 會呼叫 `apply-repository-settings.sh check`，可在可信任的本機 checkout 執行。生成 repo 開啟 enable_governance_drift_check 時，薄 Action 每日呼叫同一支程式並開立或更新一張追蹤 Issue；本模板 source repo 不排程。
summary.en: `scripts/check-governance-drift` calls `apply-repository-settings.sh check` and can run from a trusted local checkout. When a generated repository turns on `enable_governance_drift_check`, a thin Action calls the same program daily and opens or updates one tracking Issue; this template's own source repository keeps the script for local use but never schedules it.

title.zh-tw: 暫時例外｜用 Issue 保存完整責任
title.en: Temporary exception | An Issue keeps full accountability

goal.zh-tw: 方案限制與事故復原可以暫時改走人工，但不能把缺少的門禁寫成已啟用。
goal.en: A plan limitation or incident recovery may temporarily fall back to a manual process, but a missing gate may never be recorded as enabled.

code.zh-tw:
Proposer: @alice
Approver: @bob
Expires: YYYY-MM-DD
Evidence: <exact check or platform limitation>
Recovery: <command and expected result>
code.en:
Proposer: @alice
Approver: @bob
Expires: YYYY-MM-DD
Evidence: <exact check or platform limitation>
Recovery: <command and expected result>

summary.zh-tw: 每張例外 Issue 都要有提出者、另一位核准者、到期日、證據與復原方式；復原驗證後才關單，延期需重新核准。
summary.en: Every exception Issue records a proposer, a separate approver, an expiry date, evidence, and a recovery path; it closes only after recovery is verified, and any extension needs re-approval.

title.zh-tw: Copier 只詢問會改變骨架或驗證行為的選項
title.en: Copier asks only about options that change the skeleton or verification behavior

goal.zh-tw: 不提供關閉型別或秘密掃描的開關；嚴格門檻是公版契約。
goal.en: There is no switch to turn off type checking or secret scanning; the strict threshold is part of the template's contract.

code.zh-tw:
languages: [python]
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main
python_support_mode: latest  # latest | minimum
python_min_version: "3.12"  # Used only in minimum mode
coverage_mode: global  # global | diff
coverage_threshold: 80
enable_precommit: false
project_visibility: private  # public defaults CodeQL on
enable_codeql: false         # private/internal require GitHub Code Security
use_reusable_workflow: false

_skip_if_exists:
  - "src/**"
  - "tests/**"
  - "docs/specs/**"
code.en:
languages: [python]
branch_strategy: delivery  # delivery | main
python_support_mode: latest  # latest | minimum
python_min_version: "3.12"  # Used only in minimum mode
coverage_mode: global  # global | diff
coverage_threshold: 80
enable_precommit: false
project_visibility: private  # public defaults CodeQL on
enable_codeql: false         # private/internal require GitHub Code Security
use_reusable_workflow: false

_skip_if_exists:
  - "src/**"
  - "tests/**"
  - "docs/specs/**"

summary.zh-tw: 語言與分支模式都在建立時明確選擇；main 是永久整合線，delivery 模式只為 Milestone 建立短期 dev/m*。`_skip_if_exists` 保護 src、tests、spec 不被更新覆寫。
summary.en: Language and branch model are both chosen explicitly at creation time; main is the permanent integration line, and delivery mode creates a short-lived `dev/m*` only for a Milestone. `_skip_if_exists` protects `src`, `tests`, and specs from being overwritten by an update.

title.zh-tw: 公版 root 鎖工具、跑 OSV，並檢查共用設定沒有漂移
title.en: The template root pins its tools, runs OSV, and checks shared settings for drift

goal.zh-tw: 中央模板不能要求下游做到自己做不到的事；PR 說明模板是唯一刻意差異。
goal.en: A central template may not require downstream repositories to do what it cannot do itself; the PR description template is the only deliberate difference.

code.zh-tw:
uv sync --locked
uv lock --check
uv run ruff format --check
uv run ruff check
uv run ty check
./scripts/scan-secrets
# Large repositories may explicitly narrow history:
./scripts/scan-secrets --log-opts='--since=2026-01-01'
uv run zizmor . --format plain

# Paired root/template policies are diff-checked.
code.en:
uv sync --locked
uv lock --check
uv run ruff format --check
uv run ruff check
uv run ty check
./scripts/scan-secrets
# Large repositories may explicitly narrow history:
./scripts/scan-secrets --log-opts='--since=2026-01-01'
uv run zizmor . --format plain

# Paired root/template policies are diff-checked.

summary.zh-tw: root 以鎖定環境跑 Ruff、ty、完整 Git 歷史、目前工作樹與 Actions 掃描；無 Git 歷史的新案仍掃工作樹，腳本也逐組 diff root／template 的共用政策。
summary.en: The root runs Ruff, ty, a full Git-history scan, a working-tree scan, and an Actions scan from a locked environment; a new project with no Git history still scans its working tree, and the script also diffs each paired root/template policy.

title.zh-tw: Python 新功能版本觀察三十天後再人工升級
title.en: A new Python feature release is observed for thirty days before a manual upgrade

goal.zh-tw: 保留穩定版觀察期與完整驗證，不假裝已有排程或 GitHub App。
goal.en: The stable-release observation window and full verification stay in place, without pretending a schedule or GitHub App already exists.

code.zh-tw:
version_policy:
  stable_release_observation_days: 30
  update_method: manual_reviewed_pull_request
  merge_after_full_verification: manual
code.en:
version_policy:
  stable_release_observation_days: 30
  update_method: manual_reviewed_pull_request
  merge_after_full_verification: manual

summary.zh-tw: profiles/catalog.yaml 保存三十天觀察規則；維護者以一般受審查 PR 更新支援版本。舊 python-version-policy workflow 留在 archive，沒有 active bot identity。
summary.en: `profiles/catalog.yaml` records the thirty-day observation rule; a maintainer updates the supported version through an ordinary reviewed PR. The old `python-version-policy` workflow stays in the archive, with no active bot identity.

title.zh-tw: 共通基線與每個語言模組都要真的執行
title.en: The shared baseline and every language module must actually run

goal.zh-tw: 每個 beta 語言都必須真的建立、導入、更新並執行自己的原生工具。
goal.en: Every beta-stage language must actually be created, adopted, updated, and run through its own native tools.

summary.zh-tw: 共通生命週期由真實 repo 證明；每個語言模組則用可重現測試驗收，同時選取時合併執行，不另外維護組合測試。
summary.en: The shared lifecycle is proven by a real repository; each language module is accepted through a reproducible test, and selecting several together runs them combined instead of maintaining separate combination tests.
